pairs: And so they took the ark of God,
et constituerunt eam in medio tabernaculi quod tetenderat ei David:
and they set it in the midst of the tabernacle,
which David had pitched for it.
And they offered holocausts and peace offerings before God.
Cumque complesset David offerens holocausta et pacifica,
And when David had completed offering holocausts and peace offerings,
he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
And he divided to every single one,
and a piece of roasted beef,
and fine wheat flour fried with oil.
Constituitque coram arca Domini de Levitis,
And he appointed some from the Levites who would minister before the ark of the Lord,
and glorify and praise the Lord,
et glorificarent atque laudarent Dominum Deum Israël:
and second to him was Zechariah.
And Jeiel was over the instruments of the psaltery and the harps.
But Asaph sounded out with the cymbals.
Banaiam vero et Jaziel sacerdotes canere tuba jugiter coram arca fœderis Domini.
Truly, the priests, Benaiah and Jahaziel, were to sound the trumpet continually before the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
In illo die fecit David principem ad confitendum Domino Asaph et fratres ejus:
In that day, David made Asaph the leader, in order to confess to the Lord with his brothers:
notas facite in populis adinventiones ejus.
Make known his endeavors among the peoples.
Let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice!
Remember his miracles, which he has accomplished,
signorum illius, et judiciorum oris ejus,
his signs, and the judgments of his mouth.
O offspring of Israel, his servants!
O sons of Jacob, his elect!
He is the Lord our God.
His judgments are throughout all the earth.
sermonis quem præcepit in mille generationes,
the word that he instructed unto a thousand generations,
the covenant that he formed with Abraham,
Et constituit illud Jacob in præceptum,
And he appointed the same to Jacob as a precept,
and to Israel as an everlasting pact,
‘To you, I will give the land of Canaan,
they were few and were settlers there.
Et transierunt de gente in gentem,
And they passed through, from nation to nation,
et de regno ad populum alterum.
and from one kingdom to another people.
He did not permit anyone to falsely accuse them.
Instead, he reproved kings on their behalf:
et in prophetis meis nolite malignari.
And do not malign my prophets.’
Sing to the Lord, all the earth!
annuntiate ex die in diem salutare ejus:
Announce his salvation, from day to day.
Describe his glory among the Gentiles,
his miracles among all the peoples.
For the Lord is great and exceedingly praiseworthy.
For all the gods of the peoples are idols.
But the Lord made the heavens.
Confession and magnificence are before him.
fortitudo et gaudium in loco ejus.
Strength and gladness are in his place.
bring to the Lord glory and dominion.
to his name. Lift up sacrifice,
et adorate Dominum in decore sancto.
And adore the Lord in holy attire.
Commoveatur a facie ejus omnis terra:
Let all the earth be moved before his face.
For he founded the globe immoveable.
And let them say among the nations,
et omnia quæ in eis sunt.
with all that is in them.
Tunc laudabunt ligna saltus coram Domino:
Then the trees of the forest will give praise before the Lord.
For he comes to judge the earth.
and rescue us from the nations,
so that we may confess to your holy name,
and may exult in your songs.
Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel,
And let all the people say,
and let them sing a hymn to the Lord.”
Reliquit itaque ibi coram arca fœderis Domini Asaph et fratres ejus,
And so, there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, he left Asaph and his brothers,
ut ministrarent in conspectu arcæ jugiter per singulos dies,
so that they might minister in the sight of the ark continually, throughout each day,
coram tabernaculo Domini in excelso quod erat in Gabaon,
were before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place, which was in Gibeon,
ut offerrent holocausta Domino super altare holocautomatis jugiter,
so that they could offer holocausts to the Lord upon the altar of holocausts continually,
juxta omnia quæ scripta sunt in lege Domini,
according to all that was written in the law of the Lord,
and the remainder of the elect,
unumquemque vocabulo suo ad confitendum Domino,
each one by his name, were appointed to confess to the Lord:
Also Heman and Jeduthun sounded the trumpet,
and they played upon the cymbals,
and upon every kind of musical instrument,
et omnia musicorum organa ad canendum Deo:
in order to sing praises to God.
filios autem Idithun fecit esse portarios.
But the sons of Jeduthun he made to be porters.
Reversusque est omnis populus in domum suam:
And all the people returned to their houses,
so that he might bless his own house too.
